Name: Microsoft Solitaire Collection
Description: Five solitaire card games in one: Klondike, Spider, FreeCell, Pyramid and TriPeaks.

Achievements.Name: Jack of all Trades
Achievements.Description: Play 1 game of Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, TriPeaks, and Pyramid.

Achievements.Name: Victorious
Achievements.Description: Earn 20 medals total across both Windows 8 and Windows Phone devices.

Achievements.Name: Classic
Achievements.Description: Complete a game of Klondike without using the Foundation pile.

Achievements.Name: Classic Speed Run
Achievements.Description: Your fastest win times in Klondike, Spider, and FreeCell add up to 10 minutes or less.

Achievements.Name: Number Runner
Achievements.Description: Clear 5 boards in one game of TriPeaks.

Achievements.Name: Jackpot!
Achievements.Description: Earn a Cumulative Vegas score of 1,000 points in Klondike.

Achievements.Name: Journeyman
Achievements.Description: Play 10,000 Solitaire games, or begin a game on Windows 8 and finish it on Windows Phone.

Achievements.Name: Excavator
Achievements.Description: Clear 21 rows in a single game of Pyramid.
